accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio using dark espresso text (#3D271D) on cream pastel backgrounds (#FFFBF4)

keyboard_shortcuts.inventory_slots: Keys 1 to 8 select corresponding toolbar item
keyboard_shortcuts.place_item: Key [E] places active inventory item on grid
keyboard_shortcuts.pick_up_item: Key [F] collects/picks up targeted placed item
keyboard_shortcuts.modal_close: Key [Escape] closes opened menus or drawers

accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST have role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="create-room-button", data-testid="inventory-slot-1", data-testid="chat-input-field", data-testid="player-name-input")

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Fredoka' and 'Nunito' at the top of src/index.css using @import.

Do NOT use dark gradients or sleek futuristic dark themes. All non-canvas UI MUST feel like an Animal Crossing nook passport / cute cozy wooden card with soft pastel colors and rounded 3D tactile buttons.
Implement tactile button shadow effects using border-3 or border-4 in chocolate brown (#5C4033) with custom shadow-[0_4px_0_#5C4033].
The game canvas fills full width and height in background (z-0), with HUD elements overlaying on top (z-40) and modals/dialogs on top of HUD (z-50).
Include sound effect triggers (using Web Audio API synthesized cozy clicks/pops) on button presses and item selection.
Ensure every single interactive button, input, slot, tab, and badge includes a descriptive data-testid attribute for testing.

anti_slop_rules: Avoid generic dark themes or standard Vercel slate styling.
Use warm pastel background colors (#FFFBF4, #FAF0E4) paired with rich espresso brown typography (#3D271D).
Ensure elements have bold rounded borders (rounded-3xl, rounded-full) with thick 3px/4px brown borders for cozy tactile feel.
All interactive elements MUST have micro-animations (bounce, press down shadow reduction, hover scale).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
